list.name: Leader sessions
list.textFormat: A pod became leader (or a local process started its writer)

description: Standard operational dashboard shipped with jetstream (contrib/grafana). Covers local and disaggregated (PostgreSQL + S3) storage; rows marked disaggregated show no data in local mode. Expects Prometheus to scrape every pod's debug listener /metrics.

panels.title: Storage mode
panels.description: local: segments on the data dir and metadata in pebble. disaggregated: objects in S3, catalog and metadata in PostgreSQL, one leader and any number of follower pods. Detected from the catalog follower's metrics, which only disaggregated pods export.

panels.title: Phase
panels.description: Ingestion lifecycle phase. 0 is reserved for a process that never reached the dispatch loop.

targets.expr: max by (instance) (jetstream_orchestrator_phase{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"} and on (job, instance, pod) (jetstream_leader_is_leader{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"} == 1))

panels.title: Leader
panels.description: Pod running the writer session (ingest, maintainer, compaction, GC). A local deployment always shows its single process. Red means no pod holds the lease.

panels.title: Build
panels.description: Running versions. More than one value means a rollout is in progress.

panels.title: Uptime (newest pod)
panels.description: Uptime of the most recently started selected instance — shortest uptime surfaces recent restarts.

panels.title: Upstream freshness
panels.description: Seconds since the writer's live consumer last saw an upstream event. In disaggregated mode only the leader consumes the firehose, so followers are excluded. No data until steady state.

targets.expr: max((time() - jetstream_livestream_last_seen_upstream_event_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"}) and (jetstream_livestream_last_seen_upstream_event_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"} > 0) and on (job, instance, pod) (jetstream_leader_is_leader{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"} == 1))

panels.title: Subscribers
panels.description: Connected /subscribe websocket clients.

panels.title: Data dir free · local
panels.description: Free bytes on the filesystem holding the data directory.

panels.title: Firehose events/s
panels.description: Upstream subscribeRepos events decoded per second.

panels.title: Appended events/s
panels.description: Events durably appended to the active segment per second. During backfill this is dominated by repo downloads.

panels.title: Visibility p99 · disagg
panels.description: Worst pod's p99 of follower readable-log append time minus the event's witnessed_at: how long a live event takes to become servable on a pod. The headline latency SLI for disaggregated mode.

panels.title: Catalog lag · disagg
panels.description: Worst pod's time since its last successful catalog refresh. Above 10s the pod's view is stale (design S5.3 alert threshold).

panels.title: Hot backlog · disagg
panels.description: Committed hot events the leader has not yet folded into active blocks. Live appends block when this reaches the unfolded-events cap (65,536 by default).

targets.expr: max(((jetstream_hot_unfolded_events{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"} and on (job, instance, pod) (jetstream_leader_is_leader{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"} == 1)) and on (job, instance, pod) jetstream_catalog_revision{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"}))

panels.title: Writer sessions (range)
panels.description: Writer sessions started in the selected time range. In disaggregated mode each one is a leader election; in local mode, a process start. More than a handful means leadership is flapping.

panels.title: Integrity errors (range)
panels.description: Storage corruption, S3 verify failures, pebble store errors and backfill persistence errors in the selected range. Anything above zero deserves a look; see Store & integrity for the breakdown.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(jetstream_storage_corruption_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(jetstream_s3_verify_failures_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(jetstream_backfill_on_fail_store_errors_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(jetstream_backfill_completion_stage_errors_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(jetstream_store_op_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod",status="error"}[$__range])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Memory vs GOMEMLIMIT
panels.description: Worst pod's resident memory as a fraction of GOMEMLIMIT (required in disaggregated mode). No data when GOMEMLIMIT is unset.

panels.title: Firehose intake
panels.description: Upstream subscribeRepos decode results. Unknown events are archival holes a jetstream upgrade would fix.

panels.title: Relay sequence gaps
panels.description: Forward gaps in the relay's seq stream: upstream data loss, not local decode trouble. Should be flat at zero.

panels.title: Connection health
panels.description: Websocket reconnects and op=-1 error frames from the relay. Error-frame series appear only after the first occurrence.

panels.title: Replay & verify drops
panels.description: Deliberate steady-state drops (relay seq replays, stale resyncs) vs verify-queue overflow, which is permanent archival loss.

panels.title: Verifier failures
panels.description: Verifier rejections by error class. A sustained 'other' rate means a new class needs categorizing.

panels.title: Append throughput
panels.description: Writer.Append successes and failures. Append errors indicate writer trouble and should be flat at zero.

panels.title: Dropped at validation gate
panels.description: Upstream records dropped at the ingest validation gate. Spec-invalid input vs unrepresentable vs upstream omissions.

panels.title: Blocks & segments
panels.description: Local: blocks fsynced into the active segment and segment rotations. Disaggregated: blocks the maintainer folded into an active segment (uploaded or deduplicated) and segments it sealed.

panels.title: Active segment size
panels.description: Bytes in the active segment; rotation happens when it reaches the target size. Local: compressed bytes on disk. Disaggregated: framed bytes of folded blocks.

targets.expr: max(((jetstream_ingest_active_segment_bytes{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"} unless on (job, instance, pod) jetstream_catalog_revision{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"}) and on (job, instance, pod) (jetstream_leader_is_leader{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"} == 1)))

panels.title: Segment seal latency
panels.description: Local: sealing the active segment file. Disaggregated: reading the active blocks, building and uploading the footer, and committing the seal.

panels.title: Readable log
panels.description: In-memory readable log serving hot /subscribe reads. Pinned overrun means retention budget exceeded by undurable bytes. Per pod: in disaggregated mode every pod keeps its own readable log, fed by the catalog follower.

panels.title: Leader by pod
panels.description: Which pod holds the writer lease. A gap with no leader stalls ingest; followers keep serving.

panels.title: Writer session ends
panels.description: Why writer sessions ended. lease_lost: the lease could not be renewed in time (usually PostgreSQL slowness or lock contention on the archive row). fatal: the session hit an error such as a failed leader transaction. restart and shutdown are planned.

panels.title: Lease & fence errors
panels.description: Renew errors precede lease loss. Slow acquires took at least half the lease. Fence failures are leader writes rejected because the epoch moved on.

panels.title: Event visibility latency
panels.description: Per pod: follower readable-log append time minus the event's witnessed_at. Covers hot-batch admission, the PostgreSQL commit, NOTIFY, and the follower's refresh. This is what a live subscriber on that pod waits.

panels.title: Catalog follower lag
panels.description: Per pod: now minus the start of the follower's last successful refresh. Keeps growing while a refresh hangs. Followers fall back to polling if LISTEN drops.

panels.title: Catalog refresh
panels.description: Per pod: follower ticks that changed the mirror (including footer and pointer-batch fetches), and failed ticks, which keep the previous mirror.

panels.title: Catalog notifications
panels.description: NOTIFY jetstream_catalog messages each pod receives (roughly one per leader commit), and LISTEN connection failures. Without LISTEN, followers poll and visibility latency rises.

panels.title: Commit fallbacks
panels.description: One-round-trip leader commits whose fence precondition failed and ran again in two round trips. A steady trickle is normal; a high ratio to hot-batch commits costs latency.

panels.title: Writer epoch
panels.description: The leader's epoch. It increases by one at each election.

panels.title: Hot batch commits
panels.description: Hot batches committed to PostgreSQL by admission class (live, bulk) and storage (inline rows, or a pointer to an uploaded object), plus group-commit transactions.

panels.title: Hot batch shape
panels.description: Average events per hot batch and batches per group-commit transaction. Larger batches mean fewer PostgreSQL round trips per event.

panels.title: Admission wait
panels.description: Time a live append or bulk chunk waited on admission caps and permits. Sustained live waits mean the hot path is backpressured (pending bytes, inline tokens, or unfolded-events cap).

panels.title: Hot backlog
panels.description: Leader only. Committed hot events not yet folded into active blocks (live appends stop at the cap, 65,536 by default), and closed blocks waiting for the maintainer.

targets.expr: max(((jetstream_hot_unfolded_events{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"} and on (job, instance, pod) (jetstream_leader_is_leader{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"} == 1)) and on (job, instance, pod) jetstream_catalog_revision{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"}))

panels.title: Hot pending bytes
panels.description: Leader only. Raw event bytes in frozen hot batches not yet committed, by class, against the JETSTREAM_HOT_PENDING_BYTES budget, and the live inline token bucket.

targets.expr: max by (class) ((jetstream_hot_pending_bytes{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"} and on (job, instance, pod) (jetstream_leader_is_leader{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"} == 1)))

max(((jetstream_hot_inline_tokens{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"} and on (job, instance, pod) (jetstream_leader_is_leader{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"} == 1)) and on (job, instance, pod) jetstream_catalog_revision{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"}))

panels.title: Maintainer folds & seals
panels.description: Closed blocks folded into active blocks (uploaded, or deduplicated against an existing object) and active segments sealed.

panels.title: Maintainer latency
panels.description: Fold: encode, upload and commit one block. Seal: read the active blocks, build and upload the footer, commit. Rebuild: session start's catch-up, so it only has samples after an election.

panels.title: Direct writer backpressure
panels.description: Bootstrap only: backfill appends waiting for room under JETSTREAM_DIRECT_MAX_PENDING_BLOCKS or for a queued checkpoint, and how long they waited.

targets.expr: max(((jetstream_ingest_direct_append_waiters{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"} and on (job, instance, pod) (jetstream_leader_is_leader{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"} == 1)) and on (job, instance, pod) jetstream_catalog_revision{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"}))

panels.title: Direct block commits
panels.description: Bootstrap only: direct-mode block transactions and blocks group-committed per transaction.

panels.title: Transactions by kind
panels.description: PostgreSQL transactions per second. Leader kinds: hot_batch, block, objects, fold, seal, compaction, gc, metadata. Every pod: read (catalog snapshots), read_changes (follower refresh), meta_read (metastore reads).

panels.title: Transaction latency p99
panels.description: BEGIN to COMMIT/ROLLBACK. Buckets top out near 1.6s, so anything slower reads as +Inf; the session settings cap statements at 10s and lock waits at 5s.

panels.title: Transaction errors
panels.description: Transactions that failed or whose commit result is unknown. A failed leader transaction ends the writer session; reads are retried.

panels.title: Transaction time by kind
panels.description: Seconds spent inside transactions per second, by kind (rate of the duration sum). Roughly the average number of transactions in flight; the leader's fenced kinds all take the archive row lock.

panels.title: Pool connections
panels.description: Per pod: connections in use and being opened, against the pool size (JETSTREAM_PG_MAX_CONNS).

panels.title: Pool acquire waits
panels.description: Per pod: seconds per second spent waiting for a free connection (non-zero means the pool is the bottleneck), and connections opened per second (churn; each costs a TLS and auth handshake).

panels.title: S3 requests
panels.description: Every HTTP attempt by operation and result; retries count separately. not_found on get is normal for existence probes.

panels.title: S3 latency
panels.description: Attempt latency including the response body. Buckets start at 10ms, so a fast local store (SeaweedFS, MinIO) can pin at the floor.

panels.title: S3 throughput
panels.description: Object bytes moved by successful requests. get includes follower reads, compaction and merge.

panels.title: S3 errors & corruption
panels.description: Failed S3 attempts (timeouts, cancellations, errors), objects whose bytes failed the length or SHA-256 check, and storage corruption by source. Corruption should be zero.

panels.title: Objects by state
panels.description: Catalog object rows by state. Refreshed only when GC runs (JETSTREAM_GC_INTERVAL), so expect steps.

targets.expr: max by (state) ((jetstream_objects{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"} and on (job, instance, pod) (jetstream_leader_is_leader{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"} == 1)))

panels.title: Garbage collection
panels.description: GC runs by outcome, objects deleted, and delete failures.

panels.title: Object cache
panels.description: Per pod: bytes held by the decoded object cache against JETSTREAM_OBJECT_CACHE_BYTES. Full is normal; it evicts.

panels.title: GC run duration
panels.description: Average duration of the GC runs that finished in each interval.

panels.title: Backfill progress
panels.description: Repos completed this Run vs DIDs discovered via listRepos. Approximate: discovery keeps running during backfill.

targets.expr: sum((jetstream_backfill_progress_completed{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"} and on (job, instance, pod) (jetstream_leader_is_leader{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"} == 1))) / clamp_min(sum((jetstream_backfill_discovered_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"} and on (job, instance, pod) (jetstream_leader_is_leader{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"} == 1))), 1)

panels.title: Repos completed
panels.description: Repos the engine reported complete in the current Run.

panels.title: Repos failed (run)
panels.description: DIDs that exhausted their retry budget within the Run.

panels.title: Completion queue depth
panels.description: Repo completions waiting for a writer durable metadata batch.

panels.title: Repo throughput
panels.description: listRepos discovery vs getRepo completion vs terminal failure.

panels.title: HandleRepo latency
panels.description: Per-repo download+append duration, successful repos only.

panels.title: Completion durability wait
panels.description: Time a repo completion waited between being queued and becoming durable. A rising tail is a durability backlog.

panels.title: Steady-state failed-repo retry
panels.description: Retry loop that drains repos which failed initial backfill.

panels.title: Pending-pass retry queue
panels.description: The retry pass after bootstrap: candidates left, candidates requeued after a rate limit, and hosts abandoned after a long run of rate limits (their repos are recorded failed).

panels.title: Backfill engine
panels.description: Active PDS host producer loops, listRepos attempts, and how long workers wait for a fleet-wide download slot.

panels.title: Subscribers by compression
panels.description: Connected /subscribe clients by negotiated wire compression.

panels.title: Events sent to subscribers
panels.description: JSON frames written to clients, plus events removed by per-subscriber filters before encoding.

panels.title: Egress bytes
panels.description: Bytes written to /subscribe clients (post-compression for zstd) and archive getBlock downloads. sent/encoded ratio approximates the compression ratio.

panels.title: Subscriber drops & errors
panels.description: Per-subscriber trouble. Encode errors and adversarial drops should be flat at zero.

panels.title: Cursor requests by mode
panels.description: New /subscribe connections by cursor resolution outcome.

panels.title: Hot vs cold reads
panels.description: ReadFrom calls served from the in-memory readable log vs falling through to the cold disk reader, and how many subscribers are on average waiting on the shared cold replay budget (JETSTREAM_SUBSCRIBE_COLD_EVENTS_PER_SEC).

panels.title: HTTP requests
panels.description: Public-listener HTTP request rate by handler and status.

panels.title: API latency (p99)
panels.description: 99th percentile latency of the public API surfaces.

panels.title: getBlock requests
panels.description: Archive getBlock requests by outcome. Series appear after the first request.

panels.title: Compaction passes
panels.description: Delete/update compaction passes by result, plus passes triggered early by the tombstone cap.

panels.title: Rows dropped & tombstones collected
panels.description: Compaction work: rows physically dropped from rewritten segments and tombstones collected by kind.

panels.title: Tombstone set
panels.description: Entries in the live in-memory tombstone set. Drops to zero after each compaction pass.

panels.title: Compaction watermark lag
panels.description: witnessed_at lag between the sealed segment tip and the compaction watermark (header granularity).

panels.title: Compaction rewrite I/O
panels.description: Segment-file bytes rewritten by compaction.

panels.title: Sealed segments
panels.description: Sealed segments tracked by the manifest, and compaction rewrite activity per interval.

panels.title: Block index cache
panels.description: Manifest BlockIndex lookups served from resident metadata. No data while there are no cold lookups.

panels.title: Store ops · local
panels.description: Pebble metadata-store operations by op and outcome. Any error series is a crash-loud-worthy signal.

panels.title: Integrity signals (expect zero)
panels.description: Counters that should stay at zero. Storage corruption and S3 verify failures mean an object's bytes did not match the catalog. Fence failures mean a deposed leader tried to write and was rejected (the fence working, but worth a look). In disaggregated mode a few append errors at a leader handoff are expected: appends racing the session's end fail and are retried.

panels.title: Phase timeline
panels.description: 1=bootstrap, 2=merging, 3=steady state. Transitions are also marked as dashboard annotations.

targets.expr: max by (instance) (jetstream_orchestrator_phase{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"} and on (job, instance, pod) (jetstream_leader_is_leader{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"} == 1))

panels.title: Merge rev filter
panels.description: live_segments/ events surviving the rev filter into the steady-state segments vs already covered by backfill.

panels.title: Merge progress
panels.description: Run-once merge counters, shown as raw totals.

panels.title: Cutover state durations
panels.description: Total wall-clock seconds spent in each cutover state across this process lifetime.

targets.expr: sum by (state) (jetstream_orchestrator_state_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"} and on (job, instance, pod) (jetstream_leader_is_leader{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",pod=~"$pod"} == 1))

panels.title: Phase transitions
panels.description: Phase transitions per interval; normally each fires exactly once per data-dir lifetime.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Process CPU usage in cores vs the scheduler limit.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Resident set vs Go heap. GOMEMLIMIT is hidden when unset.

panels.title: Goroutines & threads
panels.description: A monotonic goroutine climb is a leak.

panels.title: GC pauses
panels.description: Stop-the-world pause durations from the Go GC summary.

panels.title: Process network I/O
panels.description: Process-level network throughput (procfs; Linux only).

title: Jetstream
